examples: Sign in to the catalog with your Google account; if you already use that email address here, you land on the same account.
how_to: Press sign in with google, type the short code it shows at google.com/device, and approve. For an address Google does not run the mailbox for, type the code we email you once. The button is greyed out until the catalog has Google configured.
media_exempt: A button beside GitHub's in the sign in panel; its screenshot is captured before the next version bump.
name: Catalog Google sign-in
summary: sign in to the catalog with Google; a verified Google address merges with the email account for the same address.
where: The top of the skills catalog, CATALOG SIGN IN, next to the GitHub button.
